Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 128: November 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #128 shipped to subscribers in October 2011 (bearing the cover date of November 2011 for Issue 128). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #128 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Need for Speed: The Run (arcade racing adventure)
LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7 (action-adventure platformer)
MotionSports Adrenaline (Kinect sports motion game)
Trine 2 (Xbox Live Arcade puzzle-platformer)
Joe Danger Special Edition (Xbox Live Arcade stunt action platformer)
Voltron: Defender of the Universe (Xbox Live Arcade twin-stick shooter)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring launch coverage for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, and Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
